releases.name: AFK CLI 0.2.42
releases.body:
## What's Changed
* feat(jev-agent-guard): support OpenCode 2.x plugin API (V2) by @easyhaloo in https://github.com/easyhaloo/afk/pull/287
* feat(distribution): make afk installable as an OpenCode 2.x plugin package by @easyhaloo in https://github.com/easyhaloo/afk/pull/286
* feat(distribution): publishable @easyhaloo/afk-opencode + tagless auto-release by @easyhaloo in https://github.com/easyhaloo/afk/pull/288
* fix(opencode-pkg): install skills on plugin load (setup), not just postinstall by @easyhaloo in https://github.com/easyhaloo/afk/pull/289
* feat: extensible capability providers and plugin management by @easyhaloo in https://github.com/easyhaloo/afk/pull/290


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/easyhaloo/afk/compare/cli-v0.2.39...cli-v0.2.42

releases.body:
## What's Changed
* test(loop): pin the run-selection rules that shipping got wrong by @easyhaloo in https://github.com/easyhaloo/afk/pull/274
* fix(runtime): count the QA rework budget per cycle, so a retry really retries by @easyhaloo in https://github.com/easyhaloo/afk/pull/275
* feat(desktop): open JumpServer assets through the jms CLI by @easyhaloo in https://github.com/easyhaloo/afk/pull/277
* fix(runtime): a worktree claim belongs to the attempt that took it by @easyhaloo in https://github.com/easyhaloo/afk/pull/278
